title: Lost 4-Year-Old In Dirty Diaper Leads Police To Irresponsible Mom
description:
On February 26th, 2025. Police responded to a situation regarding a 4-year-old boy found wandering the streets alone with a dirty diaper and no shoes.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
